profileSummary.title: Profile
profileSummary.content: I’m a frontend engineer focused on the React ecosystem (building in production since Oct 2023). I work with React, TypeScript, and Next.js, and I’ve integrated Docker-based deployments and analytics tools like Adobe Analytics. I enjoy building highly interactive, maintainable modern web applications.

achievements: Improved system architecture to speed up page load times
Introduced automated testing to reduce production incidents
Collaborated cross-functionally to ensure delivery quality

learningGoals.title: Learning & goals
learningGoals.content: Continuously improving frontend and architecture skills while actively strengthening English communication (preparing for TOEIC), aiming to collaborate smoothly with international teams.
